description:
This video discusses the challenges of evaluating machine learning models, particularly in terms of generalization, robustness, and distribution shift. It explains why high test scores do not necessarily warrant real-world success and how aggregate scores can be misleading. The video also provides a roadmap for safe deployment, including specifying auditable claims, constructing independent data splits, and stress testing against plausible shifts.

Report sources:
https://crfm.stanford.edu/2022/11/17/helm.html
https://proceedings.mlr.press/v97/recht19a
https://proceedings.mlr.press/v119/miller20a.html
thumbnailPrompt: A vivid illustration of a machine learning model being tested in different scenarios, with a mix of successful and failed predictions, highlighting the challenges of generalization and robustness.
title: The Limits of Test Scores: Evaluating Machine Learning Models
